name: mikroorm
description: MikroORM with its PostgreSQL driver, through EntityManager.transactional() inside a request context, with defineEntity entities.

modes.description: MikroORM's defaults: em.transactional(callback) in a RequestContext, allowGlobalContext false.
The documented { clear: true } option on nested and inner em.transactional() calls, so that each starts from a clear fork of the EntityManager (reused experiments T1b and T2b).
